simple.meaning: מוֹתָר (môwthâr) is a Hebrew word meaning “literally gain ; figuratively, superiority.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

occurrences.englishText: In all hard work there is profit,
The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit;

For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals; for all is vanity.
